anna_ml: Quick run: brought up nova-7b on h100 and a100 in US & EU, compared FP16/BF16, FP8 and INT8 profiles. sharing raw numbers and a short note on quality deltas. :bar_chart:

anna_ml: Summary first — FP8 gives ~1.9x token/sec vs FP16 on h100, INT8 ~1.6x. On a100 FP8 is ~1.4x, INT8 ~1.3x. Latency p50/p95 lines up with throughput; see table below. Quality drop (EM-like metric on our prompt set): FP8 ~0.9-1.6% absolute drop, INT8 ~1.8-3.5% depending on prompt type.

raj_k: which kernel/runtime flags did you use? and did you enable KV cache sharding?

anna_ml: used runtime v2.4.3, kernels: fused-attn+amx when available. flags: `--quant-profile fp8-e4m3` and `--int8-calib local`. KV cache sharding enabled for batched runs only. quick command:
```
./bench_runner --model nova-7b --profile fp8-e4m3 --device h100 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --warmup 200 --iters 1000
```

anna_ml: raw perf table (tokens/sec)
```
GPU    | FP16 | FP8  | INT8
h100   |  120k|  230k| 192k
a100   |   85k|  118k| 110k
(throughput measured with continuous batching, seq=1024, batch=8)
```

anna_ml: latency p50/p95 (ms per request, seq=512 single-stream sim)
```
GPU    | FP16    | FP8     | INT8
h100   |  48/78  |  62/100 | 55/88
a100   |  72/110 |  95/150 | 88/140
```

tess_r: thanks — nice. how are you measuring "quality drop"? which eval set?

anna_ml: used our onboarding eval harness: 1.2k instruction prompts (mix of reasoning, code, summarization). metric is normalized exact-match/score aggregated (we call it ONB-EM) and also spot-checked rouge/bleu for generative ones. example deltas: FP8 on h100: -1.0% (reasoning), -0.9% (summ), -1.6% (code). INT8: -2.2%, -1.9%, -3.1% respectively.

ben_prod: can we run a sensitivity sweep for sequence lengths <256? small-seq apps care a lot about p50.

anna_ml: yep queued a small-seq job (seq=128, batch 16) — ci-bot will post link.

ci-bot: Job queued: https://ci.internal/jobs/4567 (bench: nova-7b, fp8/int8/fp16, h100/a100, seq=128/512/1024) :rocket:

raj_k: two quick notes: 1) on a100 FP8 kernel fallback to non-fused path for some layers — that likely explains lower speedup. 2) calibration dataset size influenced int8 quality; increasing calib set from 2k->8k reduced INT8 delta by ~0.7% but added ~3-4% offline cost.

anna_ml: good call. next steps: (1) sweep FP8 variants (e4m3 vs e5m2) on h100, (2) run a100 kernel isolation to confirm fused vs non-fused impact, (3) produce capacity SLO guidance (tokens/sec per GPU with safety headroom). i'll post an internal doc with plots after the seq=128 sweep completes.

tess_r: awesome. could you add a short blurb for product about the expected user impact (latency SLOs and quality tradeoff)? they want a 99% SLA for chat features.

anna_ml: will do — TL;DR: FP8 on h100 is attractive for throughput-first workloads (batching, embeddings), but for 99% per-request latency-sensitive chat we recommend FP16 or conservative FP8 variants and additional fallback routing to FP16. will include fallback policy examples.

ben_prod: :+1: ping me when the doc is live and i'll sync with capacity planning for Dedicated pools.

anna_ml: thanks all, posting results and plots to the eng-ml drive in ~2 hours.
